description: Retrieval eval query set for Engo (Ch 4.4 S2). Each entry: id, query, expected_files (substring patterns matched case-insensitively against retrieved chunk file_name/display_name metadata), k, notes. A query PASSES if ANY expected pattern matches ANY of the top-k retrieved chunks' file names. Entries with empty expected_files are known-absent probes: no relevance assertion, the harness records best distance (documents the deferred ~0.6 threshold question). Assert top-k membership only, NEVER exact rank (Voyage embeddings are non-deterministic across calls). Engineer: extend freely — add entries with new ids; patterns must be verified to exist in the store (or deliberately absent, with expected_files []).
